relation_A_p.field_requirement: p should be prime or the search must work over a field/ring with inverses for interpolation
relation_A_p.helib_practical_choice: Use the small positive representative of A; p-A has the same field action but worse HElib scaling.
relation_A_p.sqrt_minus_one_requirement: A^2=-1 mod p exists for prime p iff p=1 mod 4
relation_A_p.support_injectivity: A must avoid (h-h')A+(lo-lo')=0 mod p for |h-h'|,|lo-lo'|<=2B except the zero difference
